name: A Precious Pet
tagline: Your pet is precious. She treats them that way.
brandNarrative:
A Precious Pet isn't a big-box salon or a harried drop-off factory — it's Charlene, a woman who once drove out on the day after Christmas to remove ticks from a dog with zero notice. That's not a policy. That's a person. Customers describe her as 'a real dog person' who genuinely connects with animals, turning a famously grumpy old dachshund into a willing participant after nothing more than a warm bath and gentle drying. She's the groomer who picks up the phone on a Saturday night and says yes — same-day appointments, last-minute pet sitting, emergency tick removal — when every other business has a two-week waitlist and an automated voicemail.

What sets Charlene apart is a combination of instinct and patience that pet owners immediately recognize. Linda's Australian Shepherd — a breed known for being headstrong — came out beautifully groomed because Charlene took the time to actually connect with the dog first. Jennifer's dog didn't just look clean after his cut; he smelled clean, which sounds obvious until you've collected your dog from a groomer who missed the point entirely. Charlene does grooming, pet sitting, and animal rescue work, which explains why animals seem to trust her quickly — she's logged the kind of hours with animals that only come from genuine love, not a job description.

Operating out of Medford, OR with extended hours six days a week (7:30 AM to 10:00 PM), A Precious Pet is built around the real, unpredictable schedules of pet owners, not the convenience of the business. With a 4.9-star rating across every review she's received, Charlene has built the kind of reputation that travels by word of mouth — because when someone's dog finally smells good and leaves the groomer happy, they tell everyone.
ownerStory:
Charlene is the heart, hands, and hustle of A Precious Pet — a one-woman operation that reflects exactly who she is: kind, responsive, and deeply committed to animals in a way that goes well beyond grooming appointments. She rescues animals, pet-sits small and exotic pets including rats, and has been known to show up on holidays when a dog needs help and there's no one else to call. Customers don't describe her as a service provider. They describe her as 'a sweet lady,' 'a very kind and caring person,' and someone who 'really connects with the dogs.' That's not a marketing line — those are the words her customers reach for unprompted.

Her work ethic is equally striking. While most groomers are booked weeks out, Charlene has a pattern of same-day and next-day availability that regular clients call 'unheard of.' She built A Precious Pet not on volume and throughput, but on genuine relationships with individual animals and their owners. Whether she's blow-drying a senior dog who hates loud noise or sitting with someone's rats on a Saturday night, she brings the same careful attention every time. In a field where burnout is common and animals often feel the stress, Charlene's approach — slow, warm, and rooted in real affection — makes the experience different from the first moment you call her.

faq.question: Can I get a same-day or last-minute appointment?
faq.answer: Yes — Charlene is well-known for accommodating same-day calls when her schedule allows. Multiple customers have been seen the same day they called, which is rare among groomers. It's always worth calling (541) 779-7770 even if you think it's too late.

faq.question: Does Charlene work with anxious or difficult dogs?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Charlene has a natural ability to calm animals down. Customers have brought in notoriously grumpy senior dogs and high-energy breeds like Australian Shepherds — and both left relaxed and well-groomed. She's patient, gentle, and takes the time to actually connect with each dog.

faq.question: Do you offer pet sitting, or just grooming?
faq.answer: Both. Charlene offers pet sitting in addition to grooming, and she's open to caring for a wide range of animals including dogs, cats, and even small exotic pets like rats. She's responded to last-minute Saturday night pet sitting requests — so don't hesitate to call even on short notice.

faq.question: What are your hours?
faq.answer: A Precious Pet is open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday from 7:30 AM to 10:00 PM. Wednesdays are closed. The extended evening hours make it easy to drop off or pick up even on busy workdays.

faq.question: Can Charlene help with tick removal or other urgent pet care?
faq.answer: Yes — one customer had ticks removed the day after Christmas with no advance notice. Charlene is willing to help in urgent situations when other providers aren't available. Call her directly and explain your situation.

faq.question: What makes A Precious Pet different from a regular grooming salon?
faq.answer: It's personal. Charlene isn't running a high-volume salon — she's building relationships with each animal and owner. Customers consistently note that their dogs seem comfortable and happy, that Charlene is genuinely kind, and that she goes well beyond what's expected. She also does rescue work, which reflects a level of commitment to animals that goes beyond the job.

brandColors.note: Soft forest green evokes warmth, nature, and gentle animal care — grounded and trustworthy without being clinical. The warm gold accent reflects the 'precious' in the name and adds a sense of love and quality. Together they feel like a backyard garden: natural, calm, and personal — exactly like Charlene's approach.

top_3_strengths: Extraordinary availability and responsiveness — same-day appointments, holiday availability, and last-minute pet sitting set Charlene apart from every competitor in the area

Genuine animal connection and patience — multiple reviewers independently note that Charlene has a natural ability to calm and connect with dogs of all temperaments, including difficult or anxious animals
Broad, flexible service offering — grooming, pet sitting, tick removal, and rescue support make Charlene a one-stop trusted resource rather than a single-service provider
common_complaints: None found — all 13 reviews are 5 stars with no negative feedback. One customer noted mild disappointment at not being able to meet Charlene in person, but this was circumstantial and not a complaint about service quality.
